title: Application are invited for 32nd Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 3rd to 7th March 2025.
bodyHtml:
Application are invited for 32nd Skill Development Programme on Pharmacovigilance scheduled from 3rd to 7th March 2025.
Mode: Online
Registration Fee: Rs. 1000/-
Last Date of Registration: 27th February 2025
Organized By: National Coordination Centre- Pharmacovigilance Programme of India, Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission
Online Registration Link:32 Skill Development Programme (SDP) on Pharmacovigilance (opens in a new tab)
